description: This Java class 'StaffHelper' provides utility methods for managing staff entities within the Apache Fineract integration test suite. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and transferring staff, primarily used for testing purposes. The class uses REST API interactions with the Fineract server and is marked with multiple deprecated annotations indicating plans for future refactoring.

classes.name: StaffHelper
classes.description: A utility class for creating, retrieving, updating, and transferring staff data via REST API in integration tests.

methods.name: transferStaffToGroup
methods.description: Transfers a staff member to a specific group using a POST request.

methods.name: transferStaffToGroupAsJSON
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload for transferring staff to a group.

methods.name: createStaff
methods.description: Creates a new staff member and returns its resource ID.

methods.name: createStaffMap
methods.description: Creates a staff member and returns its data as a map.

methods.name: createStaffWithJson
methods.description: Creates a staff member using JSON payload.

methods.name: getStaff
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific staff member.

methods.name: getStaffList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all staff members.

methods.name: getStaffListWithState
methods.description: Retrieves staff list filtered by status.

methods.name: getStaffListWithLoanOfficerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves staff list filtered by loan officer status.

methods.name: createStaffAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for creating a staff member with default data.

methods.name: getMapWithJoiningDate
